operating_model.strategy_objective_bid_structure_copy_an: defined independently by the assigned manager per request

rollout_phase.reports_and_optimization_threads: deferred until managers gain operational familiarity and Rodolfo advances the phase
rollout_phase.authority_note: the previously approved manager authority remains registered; this phase controls the active workflow and thread surface, not credential/billing boundaries

authority.scope: the assigned manager may request and authorize Campaign Ops for their own SHEIN channel, accounts and advertiser profiles

required_controls: explicit request from the assigned manager in their own SHEIN channel
live Meta account and current-budget pre-read
no blind retry after an ambiguous response

excluded: credential disclosure or credential architecture changes
ad-account ownership or Business Portfolio changes
WordPress, quiz, SMS Funnel or ChatPion configuration
automatic recurring optimization without a separately approved policy

runtime_readiness.account_write_enabled: only after the exact account/profile is validated live and registered for the request
first_request_onboarding: identify the exact Meta ad account and advertiser profile
validate token/account access without exposing credentials
read back account name, currency, timezone and health
register a short account alias inside this operation
resolve objective, optimization, bid, structure, exact budget and schedule from the manager request
run Engine v3 validate/plan when creation or cloning is requested
execute only the manager-authorized scope and verify every changed object by GET
runtime_readiness.default_campaign_delivery_state: PAUSED unless the same manager request explicitly authorizes activation or an exact schedule

credential_architecture.registry_policy: store only the 1Password item reference and safe metadata; never store or display the token value
credential_architecture.account_binding: each account alias binds to exactly one manager profile and token reference after live readback
credential_architecture.rate_limit_conclusion: separate user access tokens can isolate user-level Graph API call counts when they belong to distinct users, but Marketing API limits also apply per ad account, app, business use case, access tier, mutation burst and object; token separation is not a bypass for shared limits

spanish_pool.create_when: first authorized Spanish creative intake arrives

creative_policy.selection_gate: reconcile original and treated as one lineage, then reconcile Drive x Meta immediately before every selection/write

tracking.utm_medium: assigned manager code plus operation-approved direct-traffic suffix

reporting.activation_gate: Rodolfo advances the operation beyond campaign-creation onboarding
